scope: KISS-ICP registration threads, the last measured runtime lever in the motion stage

measured.setup: both recordings, two independent runs each, processing p50 per recording
measured.reading: a consistent gain on roundT_doubleT (-5.4 per cent in both runs) and a marginal one on doubleT_obstacle, 3.1 per cent on the medians

decisions: statuses identical and object counts identical on both recordings (13486 and 15200 objects)
why_8: the deployment stand has 8 cores and registration is the only stage that benefits from threads; it runs before the kd-tree queries, so the two do not contend
note: small, and recorded as small: this is a configuration setting, not a mechanism
